info.title: Quota Override
info.description: Submit and decide quota-override requests through the AI Hub Gateway's Quota Override API (bicep/infra/modules/quota-service/). See guides/quota-override-approval.md.

post.description: Requests more token quota for the caller's own user or team scope. The caller's identity is taken from their signed-in Entra ID token by the gateway — not from anything in this request body.

401.description: Not signed in, or token invalid.

409.description: A pending request already exists for this scope.

get.description: Requires the Quota.Approve role. Returns every pending request platform-wide — not filtered to the caller's own department yet (see guides/quota-override-approval.md for why).

401.description: Not signed in, token invalid, or caller lacks the Quota.Approve role.

post.summary: Approve or deny a quota override request
post.description: Requires the Quota.Approve role in Entra ID. The approver's identity is taken from the signed-in user's token, not from this request body.

401.description: Not signed in, token invalid, or caller lacks the Quota.Approve role.

scopeType.description: Whether this request is for the caller individually or their whole team/department.

scopeId.description: The caller's own oid (scopeType=user) or department name (scopeType=team) — same value the gateway already resolved for them elsewhere in the report.

subscriptionId.description: The access-contract subscription this quota belongs to — shown on the report page this button sits on.

currentQuota.description: The scope's current monthly token quota.

requestedQuota.description: The new quota being requested. Must be greater than currentQuota.

durationDays.description: How many days the increase should last if approved. Leave blank for the default (30 days).

requestId.description: The request's id, from the pending-requests list.

tpmTier.description: Only meaningful on approval — leave blank for standard.

scopes.user_impersonation: Access AI Hub Gateway API as the signed-in user
